boards.title: Your First Weekend at California State University-Fullerton, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A Friday-to-Sunday introduction to CSUF through campus orientation, student spaces, recreation, art, gardens, and nearby Fullerton institutions. Check linked operating schedules because summer, break, and academic-term access differs.

cards.title: Start with the campus tour team
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Titan Hall
cards.notes: Begin at Titan Hall and use the official tour resources to locate academic buildings, student services, and the weekend’s campus stops.
cards.short_summary: Get an official introduction to the campus before exploring independently.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF’s Office of Outreach, Recruitment, and Orientation provides campus tours and transition resources for prospective and new students.
cards.access_notes: Titan Hall 1203 is the listed office location. Tour schedules and registration requirements should be checked on the official site before arrival.

cards.title: Choose a Pollak Library study base
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Pollak Library
cards.notes: Walk through the library and identify a quiet seat or collaborative area you can return to when classes and group projects begin.
cards.short_summary: Turn an unfamiliar library into a practical first-semester waypoint.
cards.evidence_claim: Pollak Library provides designated study spaces, including rooms reservable by currently enrolled CSUF students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Building and service hours vary by academic term. Room reservations are limited to currently enrolled students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Map the Titan Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Student Union Way
cards.notes: Locate the study areas, food court, student offices, galleries, and lower-level Games Center so the building feels navigable later.
cards.short_summary: Learn the layout of CSUF’s multipurpose student gathering building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Titan Student Union contains study and event space, student art galleries, a food court, student offices, and the TSU Games Center.
cards.access_notes: Summer 2026 general hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; weekends are closed. Academic-term hours may differ, so verify before visiting.

cards.title: Plan a future Games Center round
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Lower level of the TSU
cards.notes: Inspect the bowling, billiards, table-tennis, arcade, and gaming options, then note which activities fit your group and budget.
cards.short_summary: Preview a social activity hub for a later open academic-term session.
cards.evidence_claim: The TSU Games Center has eight bowling lanes, twelve billiards tables, table tennis, arcade games, consoles, and PCs, with published student pricing.
cards.access_notes: The center is closed during regular summer 2026 hours except for reserved events. Check current academic-term hours before making it a weekend stop.

cards.title: Activate your recreation routine
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Gymnasium Drive
cards.notes: Bring your TitanCard, confirm membership access, and tour the exercise areas, pool, courts, or climbing wall before choosing an activity.
cards.short_summary: Use the first weekend to understand the campus recreation options.
cards.evidence_claim: Currently enrolled CSUF students receive complimentary Student Recreation Center membership; amenities include an outdoor pool, courts, exercise areas, and a climbing wall.
cards.access_notes: Access is tied to current enrollment and facility rules. Confirm the day’s operating and amenity hours before arriving.

cards.title: Pause for a residential dining meal
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Housing community
cards.notes: Use dinner to learn where residential dining sits relative to housing, then check how your TitanCard or meal plan controls entry.
cards.short_summary: Connect the campus map with the practical routine of residential dining.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF housing identifies Titan Dining Hall as the residential dining location and states that a TitanCard provides meal-plan access.
cards.source_title: Moving Day | CSUF Housing and Residential Engagement
cards.access_notes: The cited page lists weekend service from 9 a.m.–7 p.m., but dining schedules can change. Entry requires an applicable meal plan or payment.

cards.entity_name: Arboretum and Botanical Garden at Cal State Fullerton
cards.title: Take a Saturday garden walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · North edge of campus
cards.notes: Follow the garden paths slowly, compare the planted biomes, and use the official interactive map to keep the walk self-guided.
cards.short_summary: Shift from campus buildings to a documented botanical landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF describes the Arboretum as a 26-acre garden on the north end of campus and provides visitor information and an interactive map.
cards.source_title: Arboretum and Botanical Garden at Cal State Fullerton | CSUF
cards.access_notes: Consult the official Hours & Directions page before visiting; parking restrictions and special-event conditions may apply.

cards.title: Check the campus galleries
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Visual Arts Building G
cards.notes: Review the exhibition calendar first, then enter from the west side of campus and give each open gallery a focused circuit.
cards.short_summary: Add a public visual-arts stop without leaving the university.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF’s College of the Arts Galleries are in Visual Arts Building G, operate Tuesday through Saturday from 11 a.m.–4 p.m. when in season, and present free public programming.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | CSUF College of the Arts Galleries
cards.access_notes: Open 11 a.m.–4 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday, but closed during summer, winter and spring breaks, campus closures, and major holidays.

cards.title: Walk Hillcrest Park’s historic landscape
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · North Harbor Boulevard
cards.notes: Explore the Great Lawn, fountain, stonework, stairs, and shaded paths while keeping the outing within marked public park areas.
cards.short_summary: See a nearby civic park through its landscape and recreation features.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Fullerton lists Hillcrest Park as a 37.8-acre public park with a Great Lawn, historic fountain, picnic areas, recreation trails, stairs, and parking.
cards.access_notes: The city lists the park at 1200 N. Harbor Blvd. Observe posted park, stair-direction, parking, and facility-access rules.

cards.title: Finish with the city library
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · West Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Browse the public collections and note the service desks and study areas that can supplement campus resources during the semester.
cards.short_summary: Close the weekend by adding a downtown civic resource to your map.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Fullerton identifies the Fullerton Public Library at 353 W. Commonwealth Ave. and publishes public contact and operating information.
cards.access_notes: The library’s official pages display conflicting schedules; verify current Sunday opening before traveling.

warnings: Operating hours vary during summer, academic breaks, holidays, and special events; each affected card directs users to verify the current official schedule.
The Fullerton Public Library’s official pages show inconsistent hours, so Sunday access requires same-day confirmation.
